plain_english_policy: This bill is a House Resolution (HR) that serves as an official commendation from the Alabama Legislature to Tuskegee University's basketball team, known as the Golden Tigers.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would formally recognize and honor Tuskegee University for winning their first Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (SIAC) Tournament Championship in 31 years. The resolution specifically celebrates defeating Clark-Atlanta to win the title on March 6, 2010.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced this resolution to commend Tuskegee University's basketball team for their championship victory. The text explicitly states the purpose is 'to honor and commended' the university.
evidence_quotes: "WHEREAS, it is with great pride and pleasure that Tuskegee University's Golden Tigers are commended and congratulated for winning their first Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (SIAC) Tournament Championship in 31 years"
"BE IT RESOLVED BY THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES... That Tuskegee University is honored and commended on winning the Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference Basketball Tournament"
